company.name: Vendoo
company.shortDescription: Vendoo allows you to easily list items on multiple marketplaces. We help you sell more items, save time and learn about your business.
company.description:
Tired of having to track all your items, sales and messages on multiple marketplaces? Sick of manually entering the same information on every post? Vendoo is here to help! We make your selling experience quick, easy and more effective!

You no longer have to go to from one site to another to post. Vendoo allows you to fill out the details once and post that item to the marketplaces of your choice with ease.

All of your item listings, messages and sales from each marketplace are clearly displayed in one place.

We provide you with useful information to help you know your business better. The information includes your sales and customer interactions from each marketplace and your best selling items, which help you understand which marketplace works the best for you.
company.headquarters: Washington, District of Columbia, United States

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $5,125,473 to $5,125,473, a 1x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 71 (-1 over 90 days) and market heat at 76 (-5).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include List Perfectly, Crosslist, PrimeLister.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
